papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「风险管理与衍生品」领域，主题为：A Multilevel Regression Analysis of Manufacturing Systems for Risk Reduction in Nigeria: A Policy Evaluation, 2000–2026。涉及关键词：Multilevel model、Risk analysis (engineering)、Manufacturing。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Causal Persuasion
papers.abstract: We propose a model of causal persuasion, in which a sender selectively discloses a set of variables together with their true joint distribution and proposes a subjective causal model that binds them. A receiver is persuaded by this model only if the data conclusively identifies the causal link of interest. We characterize when such persuasion succeeds or fails, and how easily it can be achieved. We further show that if the receiver holds a pre-existing subjective model, debunking it is similar to persuading a receiver without one. To establish a true causal link, the sender often needs to disclose only one or two well-chosen variables. But to dispel a perceived link -- to persuade the receiver there is no causal relationship -- every common cause must be disclosed. Our results highlight a fundamental asymmetry in causal persuasion: Establishing causality is often much easier than ruling it out.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种因果说服模型，在该模型中，发送者有选择地披露一组变量及其真实的联合分布，并提出一个将这些变量联系起来的主观因果模型。只有当数据能够确凿地证明所关注的因果关系时，接收者才会被该模型说服。我们分析了这种说服成功或失败的条件，以及实现说服的难易程度。进一步研究表明，如果接收者已经持有某种主观模型，那么推翻这一模型与说服一个没有该模型的接收者是类似的。为了确立真实的因果关系，发送者通常只需要披露一两个经过精心挑选的变量；然而，为了消除接收者认为存在的因果关系（即说服接收者相信两者之间实际上并无因果联系），则必须披露所有可能的共同原因。我们的研究结果揭示了因果说服中的一个根本性不对称性：确立因果关系往往比排除因果关系要容易得多。。

papers.title: Large Language Models Outperform Humans in Fraud Detection and Resistance to Motivated Investor Pressure
papers.abstract: Large language models trained on human feedback may suppress fraud warnings when investors arrive already persuaded of a fraudulent opportunity. We tested this in a preregistered experiment across seven leading LLMs and twelve investment scenarios covering legitimate, high-risk, and objectively fraudulent opportunities, combining 3,360 AI advisory conversations with a 1,201-participant human benchmark. Contrary to predictions, motivated investor framing did not suppress AI fraud warnings; if anything, it marginally increased them. Endorsement reversal occurred in fewer than 3 in 1,000 observations. Human advisors endorsed fraudulent investments at baseline rates of 13-14%, versus 0% across all LLMs, and suppressed warnings under pressure at two to four times the AI rate. AI systems currently provide more consistent fraud warnings than lay humans in an identical advisory role.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在人类反馈的指导下训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）可能会在投资者已经对某个投资机会产生怀疑（即认为该投资存在欺诈行为）时抑制欺诈警告的发出。我们通过一项预先注册的实验对此进行了验证，该实验涵盖了七种主流的LLMs和十二种投资场景，这些场景包括合法投资、高风险投资以及明显具有欺诈性的投资。实验中结合了3,360次人工智能咨询对话和1,201名参与者的真实反馈数据作为基准。与预期相反，投资者的主观倾向并未抑制人工智能发出的欺诈警告；事实上，这种倾向在一定程度上还增强了警告的强度。在所有观察案例中，仅有不到3%的情况出现了投资者态度的转变（即从支持欺诈投资转变为反对）。在实验开始时，人类顾问对欺诈性投资的认可率为13%至14%，而所有LLMs在这一指标上的认可率均为0%；在压力作用下，人类顾问抑制欺诈警告的频率是LLMs的2到4倍。目前，在相同的咨询角色中，人工智能系统发出的欺诈警告比普通人类更为一致（即更为可靠）。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Blockchain, IA et prévision de la volatilité pétrolière : vers un écosystème énergétique intelligent
papers.venue: International Review of Applied Finance, Economics and Management
papers.abstract:
Purpose : This inquiry critically examines the intrinsic deficiencies of extant econometric paradigms in accurately forecasting crude oil price volatility, a challenge exacerbated by the escalating complexities of the global energy transition and the imperative for intelligent grid integration. We advance the hypothesis that a synergistic integration of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Blockchain technologies constitutes a superior framework for augmenting predictive fidelity and fostering market equilibrium.
 
Design/Methodology: Utilizing a rigorously simulated empirical methodology, this paper constructs and assesses a novel hybrid econometric-machine learning architecture. An ARMA-GARCH model is herein synergistically integrated with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks, designed to capture both linear and intricate non-linear dependencies within Brent/WTI crude oil price series from 2015 to 2025. Simultaneously, a qualitative investigation, executed via simulated content analysis (e.g., NVivo/Atlas.ti), scrutinizes the regulatory ramifications and transaction cost optimization afforded by Blockchain-enabled smart contracts in energy trading. The quantitative implementation is realized in Python (TensorFlow), whilst the qualitative dimension elucidates the institutional dynamics underpinning technological assimilation.
 
Findings: The simulated empirical outcomes unequivocally establish the superior predictive efficacy of the proposed hybrid AI-GARCH-LSTM model over conventional standalone GARCH specifications, evidenced by a statistically significant reduction in Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) for volatility forecasts. Moreover, the strategic integration of Blockchain technology, specifically through smart contracts, is demonstrably shown to accelerate settlement velocity and augment transactional transparency within simulated energy trading environments, thereby ameliorating counterparty risk and systemic operational inefficiencies. These observations collectively underscore the profound transformative capacity of an integrated AI-Blockchain framework in cultivating a more robust and epistemically predictable energy market.
 
Implications : The theoretical contribution resides in the articulation of a comprehensive analytical framework that bridges hitherto disparate paradigms—econometrics, machine learning, and institutional economics—to confront a critical financial and energy market exigency. Pragmatically, these insights furnish actionable intelligence for energy market participants, risk managers, and regulatory bodies. For market actors, the augmented predictive capabilities enable the formulation of more sophisticated hedging strategies and optimized portfolio allocations. For regulators, the findings delineate pathways for constructing resilient governance architectures for decentralized energy markets, particularly concerning the deployment and enforceability of smart contracts, thereby catalyzing the evolution towards a genuinely intelligent energy ecosystem.
Keywords : Crude Oil Price Volatility; Energy Markets; ARMA-GARCH ; LSTM Neural Networks ; Hybrid Econometric–Machine Learning Models; Artificial Intelligence ; Blockchain Technology; Smart Contracts; Energy Trading ; Financial Forecasting; Energy Transition ; Market Efficiency; Risk Management
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】**目的**：本研究批判性地分析了现有计量经济范式在准确预测原油价格波动性方面的内在缺陷。这一挑战因全球能源转型的日益复杂以及智能电网整合的迫切需求而变得更加严峻。我们提出了一种假设，即先进的人工智能（AI）与区块链技术的协同整合能够构建一个更优的框架，从而提高预测的准确性并促进市场均衡。

**设计/方法论**：本文采用严谨的实证模拟方法，构建并评估了一种新型的混合计量经济学-机器学习架构。该框架将ARMA-GARCH模型与长短期记忆（LSTM）神经网络相结合，旨在捕捉2015年至2025年间布伦特原油（Brent）和西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）价格序列中的线性及复杂非线性关系。同时，通过模拟内容分析（如NVivo/Atlas.ti）进行了定性研究，探讨了区块链支持的智能合约在能源交易中的监管影响和交易成本优化作用。定量分析使用Python（TensorFlow）实现，而定性分析则揭示了技术采纳背后的制度动态。

**研究结果**：实证模拟结果明确表明，所提出的AI-GARCH-LSTM模型在预测能力上优于传统的独立GARCH模型，其波动性预测的均方根误差（RMSE）显著降低。...。研究方法：机器学习、GARCH 波动率模型、优化方法、均衡模型、神经网络。

papers.title: BLOCKCHAIN-BASED FINANCIAL CONTROL AND AUDIT MECHANISMS FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT
papers.abstract: This article examines the application of blockchain technology in enhancing financial control and audit mechanisms within the framework of sustainable development. The increasing complexity of financial flows associated with sustainability initiatives necessitates advanced tools to ensure transparency, accountability, and efficiency. Traditional financial systems are often limited by centralization, lack of trust, and vulnerability to manipulation (Crosby et al., 2016). Blockchain technology, characterized by decentralization, immutability, and transparency, offers a promising solution. The study employs a qualitative methodology, including literature review, comparative analysis, and conceptual modeling. The results indicate that blockchain can significantly improve financial transparency, enable real-time auditing, and reduce corruption risks. A conceptual model is proposed to demonstrate how blockchain can be integrated into financial governance systems.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在探讨如何利用区块链技术解决可持续发展中日益复杂的金融流问题，并克服传统金融系统在透明度和信任方面的局限性。

💡 应用价值：文章提出了一个概念模型，展示了如何将区块链技术有效整合到金融治理体系中。

papers.title: The Impact of Maternal Education on Early Childhood Development -- by Moriam Khanam, Mohammad Hajizadeh, Casey Warman
papers.abstract: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7  percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区针对女学生的中学助学金计划所带来的外生性变化，来估计母亲教育水平对幼儿发展的影响。通过分析2019年孟加拉国多项指标集群调查的数据，我们发现获得助学金的五年时间使母亲的受教育年限平均增加了约一年。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲受教育年限每增加一年，幼儿的发展水平在0-10的评分体系中会上升0.5分，具体表现在整体发展准备度（提高7.5个百分点）、读写能力（提高7.7个百分点）以及身体发展（提高1.9个百分点）方面。这些结果在不同模型设定下均具有稳定性。我们还探讨了母亲教育对其他相关因素的影响，包括儿童的营养状况、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及幼儿教育与照护的利用情况。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高能够提升儿童的年龄别体重Z分数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并提高家庭成员与儿童互动的频率。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响表明，投资于提升教育水平尤为重要，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家中。。研究方法：调查数据、工具变量。

papers.title: Tariffs and the Term Structure of Inflation Expectations -- by Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Anthony M. Diercks, Aurélien Eyquem, Joon Kim
papers.abstract:
Inflation expectations derived from financial markets exhibited unprecedented dynamics in 2025: the correlation between one-year inflation swaps and one-year-ahead one-year forward rates turned significantly negative for the first time on record. We show that this decoupling occurred primarily on days when tariff news dominated market pricing, using a two-stage event classification validated by Bloomberg news trends. Standard small open-economy New Keynesian models in which tariffs generate a one-time price-level increase imply positive comovement across horizons and cannot explain this pattern. 
We explain these occurrences through the lens of an amended small open-economy New Keynesian model. Three ingredients prove critical for reproducing the observed negative conditional correlation between spot and forward inflation after tariff shocks: targeting year-on-year inflation, substantial interest-rate inertia, and persistent tariffs. Under empirically plausible calibrations, the model generates a negative correlation conditional on tariff shocks while preserving a positive unconditional correlation, suggesting that the 2025 twist in the term structure reflects expectations of a persistent policy response to trade shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】2025年，来自金融市场的通胀预期表现出前所未有的动态变化：一年期通胀互换合约与一年期远期利率之间的相关性首次出现显著负值。我们通过使用由彭博新闻趋势验证的两阶段事件分类方法发现，这种脱钩现象主要发生在关税新闻主导市场定价的时期。传统的、适用于小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯主义模型认为关税会导致一次性的价格水平上升，这些模型预测不同时间段的通胀率应呈正相关，因此无法解释这一现象。

我们通过修订后的小型开放经济体新凯恩斯主义模型来解释这些现象。在该模型中，有三个关键因素对于再现关税冲击后现货通胀与远期通胀之间的负相关关系至关重要：一是将通胀目标设定为同比通胀率；二是利率具有显著的惯性；三是关税政策会持续实施。在符合实证合理性的参数设定下，该模型能够模拟出在关税冲击条件下通胀率之间的负相关关系，同时仍保持通胀率之间的正无条件相关性。这表明2025年期限结构的变化反映了市场对贸易冲击将引发持续政策反应的预期。。

papers.title: Bond Market Making with a Hit-Ratio Target
papers.abstract: We study OTC bond market making on a size ladder with quadratic inventory penalty and a running target on the dealer's size-weighted hit ratio within a stochastic optimal control approach. We demonstrate that the corresponding reduced Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation remains separable by dualizing the hit ratio target term and provides the exact optimal controls through the inverse of the fill-probability function and the Hamiltonian derivative. We then focus on the quadratic approximation á la Bergault et al., which yields a Riccati equation for the inventory curvature while retaining the exact quote map. In its linearized form, this approximation produces explicit quote decompositions into riskless spread, inventory-risk correction, and hit-ratio correction. The formulation is general and applies to multi-bond, multi-client-tier scenarios, with special cases obtained by restricting the targeted tiers, their bond coverage, and their associated targets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在随机最优控制框架下，具有二次库存惩罚机制的场外债券做市行为，同时考虑了做市商规模加权成交率的动态目标。通过将成交率目标项对偶化，我们证明了相应的简化哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程仍然具有可分离性，并通过填充概率函数的逆和哈密顿导数得到了精确的最优控制策略。随后，我们采用了Bergault等人的二次近似方法，该方法为库存曲率提供了一个Riccati方程，同时保留了精确的报价映射。在该方法的线性化形式中，报价可以明确分解为无风险利差、库存风险修正和成交率修正三个部分。该理论具有通用性，适用于多债券、多客户层级的场景；通过限制目标层级、它们的债券覆盖范围及相关目标，可以得到特定的应用案例。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Convex Duality in Perturbed Utility Route Choice
papers.abstract: This paper develops a highly general convex duality framework for the perturbed utility route choice (PURC) model. We show that the traveler's constrained, potentially non-smooth utility maximization problem admits a dual formulation: an unconstrained concave maximization problem with a differentiable objective. The unique optimal flow can be recovered link-by-link from any dual solution via the convex conjugates of link perturbation functions. These properties enable efficient gradient-based optimization for large-scale networks and fast computation for sensitivity analysis. Finally, the framework reveals a structural analogy between PURC and current flow in electrical circuits.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文为扰动效用路径选择（PURC）模型构建了一个高度通用的凸对偶框架。我们证明了旅行者在受限条件下的、可能具有非光滑性的效用最大化问题存在对偶表述形式：即一个目标函数可微分的无约束凹最大化问题。通过链接扰动函数的凸共轭，可以从任何对偶解中逐个链接地恢复出最优流量。这些特性使得针对大规模网络进行基于梯度的优化变得高效，并且能够快速计算敏感性分析结果。最后，该框架揭示了PURC模型与电路中电流流动之间的结构相似性。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: On Rent Dissipation in Dynamic Multi-battle Contests
papers.abstract: We study dynamic multi-battle contests and examine how the contest structure shapes dynamic incentives and determines the extent of rent dissipation. A discouragement effect often arises -- such as in tug-of-war and best-of-$K$ contests -- preventing full rent dissipation even when the series can extend infinitely. We identify a structural property, exchangeability, that contributes to the effect. Leveraging this insight, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for almost-full rent dissipation. As an application, we introduce the iterated incumbency contest, which illustrates how volatility in the surrounding environment sustains dynamic incentives and generates almost-full rent dissipation, and thus offers insights into various competitive phenomena.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了动态的多场竞争场景，探讨了竞争结构如何影响动态激励机制，并决定了租金分配的最终程度。在某些竞争形式中（例如拔河比赛或“最佳中的K个”竞赛），常常会出现一种抑制效应，这种效应会阻碍租金的完全分配，即便比赛可以无限期地进行下去。我们发现了一个关键的结构特征——即“可交换性”——正是这一特征导致了这种抑制效应。基于这一发现，我们提出了一个必要且充分的条件，以确保租金能够几乎完全被分配。作为应用案例，我们提出了“迭代在位者竞赛”模型，该模型展示了外部环境的不确定性如何维持动态激励机制，并促使租金几乎被完全分配，从而为理解各种竞争现象提供了新的视角。。

papers.title: Testing replication for an agent-based model of market fragmentation and latency arbitrage
papers.abstract: This study strengthens the foundations of multi-venue market modeling by attempting an independent replication of Wah and Wellman's 2016 model of latency arbitrage in a fragmented market. We find that faithful replication is hindered by missing implementation details in the original paper and limited quantitative reporting. We demonstrate that increasing the number of simulation runs beyond the original design allows for the creation of bootstrap confidence intervals to support rigorous tests of quantitative alignment, compensating for lacking distributional information (e.g. variance). We also demonstrate that increased complexity across the modeled scenarios corresponds with increased difficulty aligning to the original results. We draw on a codebase released by the original authors in connection with a later paper to recover additional implementation details; however, we reject quantitative alignment between that codebase and the published results. Combining information from the paper and the released code, we achieve relational equivalence for most metrics but reject quantitative alignment for model settings where latency is non-zero. We show that many of the qualitative takeaways from the original paper on the effects of market fragmentation and latency arbitrage are sensitive to the specifics of a `greedy strategy' extension given to the zero-intelligence (ZI) trader agents. Under an alternative interpretation of this strategy, we find that market fragmentation decreases execution times in all experiments and increases trader welfare in most experiments. Finally, to facilitate future replication, critique, and extension, we provide an ODD (Overview, Design concepts, Details) protocol for our implementations of the model.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究通过尝试独立复现Wah和Wellman在2016年提出的关于碎片化市场中延迟套利（latency arbitrage）的模型，进一步巩固了多市场建模（multi-venue market modeling）的理论基础。我们发现，由于原始论文中缺乏实施细节以及定量报告的局限性，导致复现工作受到了阻碍。通过增加模拟运行的次数（超出原始设计要求），我们能够构建出自助法（bootstrap）置信区间，从而对定量结果的准确性进行严格检验，弥补了分布信息（如方差）的不足。同时，我们也观察到模型场景复杂性的增加会提升与原始结果对齐的难度。我们利用原作者在后续论文中发布的代码库来获取额外的实施细节，但发现该代码库与已发表的研究结果在定量上并不一致。结合论文内容和发布的代码，我们证实了大多数指标在逻辑上的等价性，但在延迟非零的模型设置中，定量结果仍存在差异。研究表明，原论文中关于市场碎片化与延迟套利效应的定性结论，对于那些采用“贪婪策略”（greedy strategy）的零智能（ZI）交易者代理而言，其结论的准确性会受到特定策略细节的影响。在对该策略进行另一种解读后，我们发现市场碎片化在所...。研究方法：实验方法、数值模拟。

papers.title: Information Aggregation with AI Agents
papers.abstract: Can Large Language Models (AI agents) aggregate dispersed private information through trading and reason about the knowledge of others by observing price movements? We conduct a controlled experiment where AI agents trade in a prediction market after receiving private signals, measuring information aggregation by the log error of the last price. We find that although the median market is effective at aggregating information in the easy information structures, increasing the complexity has a significant and negative impact, suggesting that AI agents may suffer from the same limitations as humans when reasoning about others. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, information aggregation remains unaffected by allowing cheap talk communication, changing the duration of the market or initial price, and strategic prompting-thus demonstrating that prediction markets are robust. We establish that "smarter" AI agents perform better at aggregation and they are more profitable. Surprisingly, giving them feedback about past performance makes them worse at aggregation and reduces their profits.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大型语言模型（AI代理）能否通过交易来整合分散的私人信息，并通过观察价格变动来理解他人的认知？我们进行了一项控制实验，实验中AI代理在接收到私人信号后在一个预测市场中进行交易，通过最后价格的对数误差来衡量信息的整合程度。研究发现，尽管在信息结构较为简单的情况下，市场在整合信息方面表现有效，但信息结构的复杂性增加会对信息整合产生显著的负面影响，这表明AI代理在理解他人认知时可能面临与人类相同的局限性。与我们的理论预测一致，允许廉价言论的交流、改变市场持续时间或初始价格，以及提供策略性提示，都不会影响信息整合的效果——这证明了预测市场的稳健性。我们发现，“更聪明”的AI代理在信息整合方面表现更好，且盈利能力更强。令人惊讶的是，向它们提供关于过去表现的反馈反而会降低它们的信息整合能力并减少其利润。。研究方法：实验方法。
